Delivery Time Delay Anomaly Detector

Evaluates 3,000 orders across five urban dispatch clusters. Flags courier delivery delays exceeding SLA thresholds and predicts dynamic ETA adjustments.

SLA Delay Threshold 35 mins
Strict (25 min) Relaxed (50 min)

Chart: Actual Duration (bars) vs ML Prediction (line) R² = 0.71 · AUC = 0.78 
-- DoorDash Order Delay Anomaly Detection Feature Pipeline
WITH order_base AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        zone_id,
        created_at,
        actual_delivery_duration_sec / 60.0 AS actual_mins,
        predicted_duration_sec / 60.0 AS pred_mins,
        item_count,
        subtotal_usd,
        courier_id,
        AVG(actual_delivery_duration_sec / 60.0) OVER (
            PARTITION BY zone_id 
            ORDER BY created_at 
            ROWS BETWEEN 50 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_zone_mean_mins,
        STDDEV(actual_delivery_duration_sec / 60.0) OVER (
            PARTITION BY zone_id 
            ORDER BY created_at 
            ROWS BETWEEN 50 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_zone_std_mins
    FROM doordash_warehouse.fact_deliveries
    WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'
)
SELECT 
    order_id,
    zone_id,
    actual_mins,
    pred_mins,
    (actual_mins - rolling_zone_mean_mins) / NULLIF(rolling_zone_std_mins, 0) AS delay_z_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN (actual_mins - rolling_zone_mean_mins) / NULLIF(rolling_zone_std_mins, 0) > 2.2 THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS is_anomaly_breach
FROM order_base;
